artifacts.notes: Exact span map: Cummiskey 1861 praefationes-la seq 3, first 8 words and PerChristum through dicentes; Wilson 1894 BookI XL printed69, four words after VD before ut spiritalis; Paris: Jouby 1859 printed398, entire ut spiritualis through induantur. Wilson baptismum, spiritalis and innocens odor remain unchanged in their source and are not imported.1859 positively supplies the target petition readings. Source potestates; differs in pointing/case from target Potestates.; source caps/pointing stay. This is exact target prayer-word agreement under declared transformations, not a single-old-witness, full-execution, ritual-applicability or whole-Missal claim.
artifacts.rights_basis: Triptych’s bounded source selection, span mapping and editorial projection are CC BY 4.0. Every underlying Latin word is independently preexisting public-domain material in Cummiskey 1861, Wilson 1894 and Pontificale Romanum Paris: A. Jouby 1859. The projection does not reproduce modern typography, chant notes, layout, target rubrics or protected modern additions. No exclusive right is claimed in underlying Latin. The later 1962 scan is solely a comparison witness.
